annotations.title: Compare a CV with a vacancy

description: Compare a CV with one vacancy (vacature, job ad), requirement by requirement, with exact quotes from both, missing ATS keywords and the fixes to make first. Use when the user asks 'do I fit this job', 'past mijn cv bij deze vacature' or shares a vacancy with their CV. Uses AI and is rate-limited; nothing stored. Never advise claiming experience the user does not have. The result includes nextStep, a suggested follow-up.

cv_text.description: The full text of the CV (200-25,000 characters). Remove BSN, ID and bank numbers first.

locale.description: Language of the CV and the answer. Detected from the text when omitted.

vacancy_text.description: The full vacancy text: requirements and responsibilities (120-18,000 characters).

name: match_vacancy

missingKeywords.description: Short keywords only, deduplicated, most important first.

suggestedUserPrompt.description: A short line the agent can say to the user, in the CV's language.

cvQuote.description: Exact text from the CV that supports the status. Null when missing.

gap.description: For partial/missing: what exactly is not shown, e.g. 'Google Analytics genoemd, GA4 niet'.

honestAction.description: What to add IF it is true. Never suggest claiming experience the user does not have.

keywords.description: Short ATS keywords for this requirement, e.g. ['GA4']

requirement.description: Short, one thing only: 'Meta Ads', not 'Google Ads en Meta Ads'.

example.description: Optional rewritten line in the CV's language. Must not invent facts; use [X] for numbers the user must fill in.

problem.description: One sentence: what is wrong, with the measured value where there is one.

quote.description: Exact text copied from the CV that this fix is about. Null when the problem is something missing.

where.description: Human location, e.g. 'Werkervaring > Marketing Coördinator, bullet 1'. Null for CV-wide issues.

title: Compare a CV with a vacancy
